quote: The company reached this milestone yesterday with the submission to the Environmental Evaluation Service (SEA) of its Solar Oriente project, which involves an investment of US$990 million for an installed capacity of 581 MW photovoltaic and 809 MW of storage in the commune of Pozo Almonte, Tarapacá Region.
note: Opened AES Andes English; US$990m / 581 MW PV + 809 MW BESS / Pozo Almonte SEA confirmed.
